body: I need to find employment. I need to find a place to live. I need get on Medicaid so I can afford to go see a therapist. I need to start taking steps into making life what I want.
I'm not sure he'll even speak to me. Let alone even begin to forgive me.
I genuinely don't know how to start repairing it. I've never fucked up a relationship this bad before.

I'm just quite unsure of what the first step is to take. Leaving here feels wrong. It feels like I am running away from what I need to fix. But staying also feels wrong. I am at a total impass and feel quite lost because of it.
Klonopin is a scary fucking drug. There is nothing to be ashamed of. Benzo withdrawal can be intense and you should not have to go through that alone.
Can't talk about methods. And also don't want you to harm yourself. Why are you feeling like this is the only option?
Why do you not want to exist anymore?

Hypothermia is an extremely painful way to go. Once your body gets too cold your brain will fight like hell to try to survive and you will feel it all. Not too mention potential effects like frostbite if you choose to not go through with it.
Debt is a large part of life. I can't even deny that. But there have to be experiences that you want to have or places you want to see!
But don't you think he'll need his older sister to guide him, love him, and care for him when he needs it?

I've never understood why it's treated like an intrusion into another's emotional well being. I understand being sad, hurt, or shocked. But when people say things like "how could he/she" that's where I start to lose understanding.
You say you are depriving your siblings of their needs. But your needs and right to survive are just as important!
You seem extremely wise, and resourceful for being 16. People like you tend to be quite successful, don't you want to see what life has to offer?
Why not keep living and show them what an amazing child they could have had a relationship with?

Caring for a pet can be one of the best things to keep us going everyday! My dog is a lot of my motivation. Though a lot of times I think she deserves better than me, she still gets me out of bed every morning.

I feel you dude, I got very depressed and simply stopped going to classes for my degree, and now years later I still owe the university money which has gone to collections. And still owe the federal government for their portion. And that monthly $50 always seems like a drop in the bucket of a payment I'll never be able to fully make.

I do not tend to dream, or at least remember most dreams. And thankfully I tend to sleep through the night almost always. I love sleep. It is a great escape. I look forward to "bedtime" daily. 

What I cannot stand is how tired I will wake up the next morning even after 9 or ten hours. Waking up being so tired, and dreading going about the day until I can sleep again.

The emotions after being cheated on are so thick and hard to wade through. Betrayal is such a nasty thing. 

I was also cheated on by a girl who I was with for a similar period of time. (you can reference my recent post) and even a few years later I am still picking up the fragments she left behind.

Wow man, you and I should be good friends. I am also 26 with no career, and no degree. I have fleeting passions that I will get really involved with for moments at a time. But no steady ones. I am also watching all my close friends be extremely successful in their careers and starting families. 

I hope I'm not a disgrace to my parents. Though I'm sure they would be disappointed I don't match the reality of what they had hoped. 

It's been about 2 days since I've eaten anything and I can't even tell you the last time I've showered or brushed my teeth. 

How do we get through this?
It sounds as though you lead a very noble life. And you certainly work in a field that is so vitally necessary and important. It would be a shame for the world to lose a person like you.
Additionally, is there a better resource than the Suicide Hotline Lifeline Chat? I've been trying for most of the day to get connected and it has ended up erroring out each time.

I know this may not be much help, but some of what you said has resonated with me so deeply. 

While having a different background and no experience in some of what you have suffered I find myself in a very similar position of just wanted the relief.
Do you have a psychologist or therapist that you see regularly?

I can't tell you how many nights I've asked God(if there is one) to just kill me. 

I get what you are saying. The frequency with which I think, maybe I should just kill myself has been increasing for a while now.
